micPermissionDenied.generic: 운영 체제에서 마이크 접근을 거부했습니다. 시스템 설정에서 마이크 권한을 허용해 주세요.
micPermissionDenied.windows: 설정 → 개인 정보 및 보안 → 마이크(데스크톱 앱 접근 포함)에서 마이크 접근을 활성화하세요.
micPermissionDenied.macos: 시스템 설정 → 개인 정보 보호 및 보안 → 마이크에서 마이크 접근을 허용하세요.
micPermissionDenied.linux: 시스템의 소리 또는 개인 정보 설정에서 마이크 접근을 허용하세요.

errors.noInputDevice: 오디오 입력 장치가 감지되지 않았습니다. 마이크 또는 헤드셋을 연결한 후 다시 시도해 주세요.
errors.gpuUnavailableUsingCpu: GPU transcription unavailable on this hardware - using CPU.
errors.pasteFailed: 활성 애플리케이션에 텍스트를 붙여넣을 수 없습니다.
errors.pasteFailedCopiedHint: The text was copied to your clipboard so you can paste it manually.
errors.languageGuardDescription: Verbatim blocked text that did not match your locked language ({{language}}). It was copied to your clipboard.
errors.transformRecoveryCopiedDescription: The selected text was transformed, but Verbatim could not replace it in the active app. The result was copied to your clipboard.
errors.transformSecureFieldDescription: Verbatim cannot transform selected text from password or secure fields.
errors.transformSecureCheckErrorDescription: Verbatim could not verify whether this field is secure, so no text was read or sent.
errors.coordinatorFailedMessage: The dictation coordinator stopped after repeated failures. Restart Verbatim to recover.
errors.coordinatorRestartedDescription: Verbatim recovered the dictation worker. If this keeps happening, open logs from Debug settings.
errors.startupFailedDescription: Verbatim could not finish startup. Use the recovery actions below, or open the logs for details.
errors.targetChangedDescription: The active destination changed before Verbatim inserted text. Use Paste here only if the current field is the right destination.
errors.targetPrivacyExcludedDescription: The active app matches a private-app exclusion. Verbatim did not start recording.

onboarding.title: Set up mobile dictation
onboarding.subtitle: Enable the Android permissions Verbatim needs before the floating mic bubble can type for you.

microphone.title: Let Verbatim hear you
microphone.description: Verbatim needs your microphone to transcribe what you say.

overlay.title: Show the mic bubble
overlay.description: The bubble floats over your other apps so you can dictate without switching away.
overlay.callout: Opens system Settings. Toggle 'Allow display over other apps' and return to Verbatim.

accessibility.title: Type into any app
accessibility.description: Verbatim uses Android's accessibility API to insert text wherever your cursor is, like a keyboard.
accessibility.callout: Can insert your transcribed text. Does not log screen text or app content.

disclosure.title: Verbatim의 접근성 사용 방식
disclosure.body: Verbatim은 사용자를 대신해 입력하기 위해 Android 접근성 서비스(AccessibilityService API)를 사용합니다. 활성화하기 전에 정확히 어떤 일을 하는지 알려드립니다:
disclosure.insertsText: 떠 있는 Verbatim 버블을 탭하면 현재 입력 중인 텍스트 필드에 받아쓴 텍스트를 삽입합니다.
disclosure.fieldAccess: 커서 위치에 단어를 배치하기 위해 포커스된 텍스트 필드의 위치와 내용만 읽습니다. 비밀번호 및 기타 민감한 필드는 건너뜁니다.
disclosure.noCollection: 화면 콘텐츠를 절대 수집, 저장, 공유하지 않습니다. 음성은 이 기기에서 변환되며 어떤 것도 기기 밖으로 전송되지 않습니다.

speech.title: Use on-device speech
speech.description: Verbatim starts dictation only when Android can recognize speech on this device.
speech.readyCallout: Speech recognition stays on-device for this prototype.
speech.missingCallout: Install an offline speech pack or use a device with on-device speech. Verbatim will not silently use remote speech.

model.title: Download a speech model
model.description: Choose a local model so Android dictation uses Verbatim's offline transcription path.
model.callout: Same local model requirement as desktop dictation. Downloads stay under your control.
model.readyCallout: Local model is ready for offline dictation.

speechPack.title: Download offline speech pack
speechPack.description: Install the local Android speech pack for your current language before dictation starts.
speechPack.callout: Verbatim will request Android's on-device model download and will not use remote speech recognition.
speechPack.readyCallout: Offline speech pack is ready for this device language.
speechPack.pendingCallout: Android scheduled the speech pack download. Keep the device online and try again after it finishes.
speechPack.downloadingCallout: Android is downloading the on-device speech pack.
speechPack.errorCallout: Android could not start the speech pack download. Check network or language settings and try again.
speechPack.unsupportedCallout: Android did not report a downloadable on-device speech pack for this language.

bubble.activeSubtitle: The bubble appears only while a text field has the keyboard open.
bubble.inactiveSubtitle: Finish setup before the keyboard-triggered bubble can appear.

lastTranscript.title: Last transcript
lastTranscript.empty: Dictate with the bubble to build your history.

models.empty: No Android model packs are available.
models.requiresRam: Requires at least {{minRamGb}} GB RAM; this device reports {{totalRamGb}} GB.

elevatedWindow.body: {{app}}이(가) 관리자 권한으로 실행 중이므로 Windows가 Verbatim의 입력을 차단합니다. {{app}}을(를) 일반적으로 다시 실행하거나 Verbatim도 관리자 권한으로 실행하세요.
